description: China A-share INDUSTRY-SECTOR main-capital net inflow summed over the last N trading days (default 5; use 3, 5 or 10), with how many days in a row each sector has had net inflow or outflow. Answers '最近5日行业主力资金净流入排名', '板块连续3日净流入', '连续流入天数', 'which sectors had the most main-capital net inflow over the last 10 trading days', 'sectors with net inflow for 3 days running', 'sector fund flow 5-day ranking'. Per sector: summed main net inflow (主力净流入) and its order-size split (超大单/大单/中单/小单) in CNY, inflow and outflow day counts, the current consecutive inflow or outflow streak, cumulative change %, and the day-by-day net inflow. Rank with `sort` (summed inflow, streak length, cumulative change, inflow days) and filter one sector with `sector` (name fragment or board code). Eastmoney industry boards (行业板块), roughly 128 sectors, history from 2021-11; not the Shenwan classification. For a single day use ashares_sector_capital_flow. Source: Eastmoney datacenter (keyless).

days.description: Window length in trading days, 1-20 (default 5; 3, 5 and 10 are the common asks).

end_date.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD (default: most recent day with published data).

order.description: desc (default, largest first) or asc (largest net outflow / shortest streak first).

sector.description: Only sectors whose name contains this text (e.g. "半导体") or whose board code equals it (e.g. "BK1036").

sort.description: Rank by summed net inflow (default), current consecutive inflow streak, cumulative change %, or number of inflow days.
